metadata.question: Does the forest fire burn over 0.8 million hectares of land in Quebec, Canada in 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Need burn area/severity data - MODIS Burned Area (MCD64A1) or Sentinel-2 NBR for fire detection - Date: 2023 fire season (typically May-September in Canada, but should check full year) - Location: Quebec, Canada province boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS MCD64A1: Use burn date band (BurnDate > 0 indicates burned area) - Calculate total burned area in hectares - Compare against 0.8 million hectares (800,000 ha) 3. Logic: - Valid result: If we get a numeric burned area value - A: If burned area >= 800,000 hectares - B: If burned area < 800,000 hectares - C1: If no data available for Quebec in 2023 - C2: If no burned pixels detected (count = 0) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Quebec boundary const quebec = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Quebec') )) .geometry(); // 2. Load MODIS Burned Area for 2023 const burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-12-31') .filterBounds(quebec) .select('BurnDate'); const collectionSize = burnedArea.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No burned area data available for Quebec in 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Create binary burn mask (any pixel that burned in 2023) const burned = burnedArea.map(function(img) { return img.gt(0); }).max(); // Maximum across all months creates binary burned/not-burned // 4. Calculate burned area // Each MODIS pixel is ~463m x 463m = ~21.4 hectares at equator // Use pixelArea() for accurate calculation const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000); // Convert to hectares const burnedAreaImage = burned.multiply(pixelArea); // 5. Sum total burned area const stats = burnedAreaImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e10 }); const totalBurnedHa = stats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); // 6. Count burned pixels for validation const pixelCount = burned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e10 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Burned pixels: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Total burned area: ${totalBurnedHa} hectares`); console.log(`Total burned area: ${(totalBurnedHa / 1000000).toFixed(2)} million hectares`); // 7. Validation and answer if (totalBurnedHa === null || totalBurnedHa === undefined || isNaN(totalBurnedHa)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); } else if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No burned pixels detected in 2023'); console.log('C2'); } else if (totalBurnedHa >= 800000) { console.log('Burned area exceeds 0.8 million hectares'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Burned area is less than 0.8 million hectares'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
